extraction_notes: Extracted main-text measured performance from Fig. 1 only. Fig. 2A is an Arrhenius plot and Fig. 2B–D are reaction-order plots, so they were skipped. Fig. 3 is a best-fit/model comparison for rate-determining-step analysis and was skipped. Figures 4–6 are characterization. Pressure in Fig. 1A is read as the plotted x-axis positions (approximately 1, 10, 20, and 30 bar); the first point is very close to the origin and is interpreted as about 1 bar/atmospheric pressure. Outlet NH3 values in Fig. 1A/B were read from the right axis, which is aligned with the rate axis.
